facts.fact: 她把私愿包装成请战：先去 Haven 打掉 Collector 的行动当作试运行——话说得像建议，意思很明确：妹妹等不起。
facts.anchor: “I volunteer to go to the Haven first,” I said. “Topple the Collector’s operation as a test run.”

facts.fact: Commander Lee 提议让专家评估、编目她的力量，Nikolai 打断：她的身份是机密，不许碰、不许围、不许审、不许测试。
facts.anchor: “Cadet Max Morning is classified,” Nikolai interrupted.

facts.fact: Caspian 接话升级：连看她的眼神不对都不许——语气已接近威胁。
facts.anchor: “And no one looks at her wrong,” Caspian added

facts.fact: Aelindor 一句话关门：她只对四位继承人负责，谁伤她谁死；并当众说明她不只是资产或国安事务，而是对他四人「个人上重要」。
facts.anchor: She answers to no one but us. Anyone who harms her dies.

facts.fact: 满屋军官点头听令时，Lady Vaelith 的镇定裂了一瞬——一丝受伤一闪即隐；她也始料未及。
facts.anchor: A flash of hurt, there and gone.

facts.fact: Nikolai 宣布：召开 Zodiac Covenant 史上第一次三冠会议，正式邀请 New Columbia 与 Haven 到首都，议题是变异兽威胁与苍白宫廷的实验。
facts.anchor: we’re calling the first Tri-Crown Accord in the history of the Zodiac Covenant.

facts.fact: 她算出的政治解法：Collector 若能受邀前来，Aelindor 可以把「带回 Missy」设为入席前提——不必偷渡敌境，他会亲手把妹妹送进城门。
facts.anchor: If the Collector came here, Aelindor could compel him to bring Missy as a precondition of the invitation

facts.fact: 她意识到自己差点为一个「甚至不属于她」的男人当众掐住一位 Fae 贵妇的喉咙，并第一次自问：我是在陷落吗？
facts.anchor: This was what falling for the heirs did to a woman. And was I? Falling?

facts.fact: Vaelith 的情报：数月来大陆流传「两个 Zodiac 家族的失落继承人终于现身」，竞争性说法与伪造故事混杂，而传闻把此人定位在 Covenant 墙内。
facts.anchor: the lost heir of two Zodiac Houses has finally surfaced

facts.fact: 章末 Aelindor 定论：Xander 会来，他会越境来拿走不属于他的东西——她心里补上那个词：我。
facts.anchor: “Xander will come,” Aelindor said. “He’ll cross into our territory to take what isn’t his.”
